item.title: Smoked duck sandwiches, chia seed pudding, and tater tots: Introducing the new Ohlone-crafted cafe at Lawrence Hall of Science
item.description: Smoked duck sandwiches, chia seed pudding, and tater tots: Introducing the new Ohlone-crafted cafe at Lawrence Hall of Science The UC Berkeley science center launched 'ammatka from Vincent Medina and Louis Trevino in February as part of its larger 'ottoy initiative.

item.title: Celebrating Betty Reid Soskin, civil rights storyteller and park ranger
item.description: Celebrating Betty Reid Soskin, civil rights storyteller and park ranger About 1,000 people gathered in Oakland Sunday to honor “Miss Betty,” once the nation’s oldest park ranger, whose vision helped ensure that the Rosie the Riveter museum was inclusive of all experiences.

item.title: Major mural of Oakland Olympic champ Alysa Liu goes up in Temescal
item.description: Major mural of Oakland Olympic champ Alysa Liu goes up in Temescal Bay Area artist collective The Illuminaries put up the homage late last week with the figure skater’s iconic ‘thizz face.’

item.title: DA may drop most charges in bribery and perjury case against Oakland police detective
item.description: DA may drop most charges in bribery and perjury case against Oakland police detective The Alameda County District Attorney’s Office is considering dropping all but one charge against veteran OPD detective Phong Tran in relation to a botched murder case.

item.title: Did ICE arrest a truck driver in Oakland?
item.description: Did ICE arrest a truck driver in Oakland? A video taken last Tuesday near the Port of Oakland shows unidentified federal agents arresting a truck driver. Where he is now is a mystery.

item.title: Oaklandside’s Ashley McBride, Callie Rhoades receive First Amendment award
item.description: Oaklandside’s Ashley McBride, Callie Rhoades receive First Amendment award The pair are being honored by the First Amendment Coalition with its Free Speech and Open Government Award for their reporting last year on the lead crisis in Oakland public schools.

item.title: Anti-Jewish graffiti around Lake Merritt is under investigation
item.description: Anti-Jewish graffiti around Lake Merritt is under investigation Violent messages, which included a swastika, have been spray-painted in Oakland in several recent incidents.
